title: RAG quality differs by evidence task
method: Synthetic 90-case set with 30 cases per category. Success is 27/30 direct answers, 18/30 synthesis answers, and 21/30 appropriate declines on unsupported questions. Different category definitions are explicit; these are not benchmark results.
alt: RAG quality differs by evidence task. Direct lookup: 90 percent successful within 30 cases, Cross-document synthesis: 60 percent successful within 30 cases, Appropriate decline: 70 percent successful within 30 cases. Illustrative data.
